question: What is Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS)?
answer: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is one of the most common endocrine disorders, affecting 5%-10% of women of reproductive age. It is defined by at least two of the following abnormalities: oligo- and/or anovulation, clinical and/or biological hyperandrogenism, and polycystic ovaries [Source: Markers of insulin resistance in Polycystic ovary syndrome women]. Please consult a healthcare provider for personalized advice.
